_meta.measured_scope: daily resolution, survivorship-biased current ~708-name universe, raw OHLC, ~13 known unadjusted corporate-action rows
_meta.unverified_scope: every lower-timeframe (60m..1m) entry-timing condition — no per-stock intraday history exists to backtest it; design-only, for forward paper shadow mode

entry_conditions.setup: pullback to EMA20 (low<=EMA20*1.02 or |close/EMA20-1|<=2%) AND close>EMA20 (reclaim)

exit_conditions.primary_measured: v4: no take-profit, stop 2.5xATR on daily close, exit next open if breached, time-exit 20 sessions
exit_conditions.alt_tested: target +3xATR / stop -1.5xATR, stop-first if both touched

strategies.target_methodology: research target = entry + 3xATR (finite, positive); used for actionability/upside/RR gating
strategies.missed_entry_behaviour: if next-open gap>4% or price above buy zone -> MISSED_ENTRY/WAIT, no fill
unsupported_data_conditions: no per-stock intraday -> 15m/60m triggers not evaluated

entry_conditions.relative_strength: stock ret20>NIFTY ret20 AND ret63>NIFTY ret63 AND ret120>NIFTY ret120 (ablation: this triple filter slightly LOWERS expectancy, mainly cuts trades — consider relaxing to ret63 only)
entry_conditions.trigger_measured: renewed strength: close>close[t-1] AND close>EMA20; next-open

unsupported_data_conditions: sector-relative strength NOT computed (no sector map wired) — uses NIFTY-relative only

entry_conditions.volume_filter: DROP — ablation showed relative-volume>=1.2 REDUCES expectancy (+0.32 when removed)

measured_results.regime: only strategy positive in BOTH bull(1.32) and sideways(1.27)

entry_conditions.lower_tf_alignment: REMOVE — ablation: the multi-horizon alignment gate (ret5>0 & ret10>0 & ret20>0) LOWERS expectancy by 0.70%/trade; keep only as design-only intraday confirmation in shadow mode

unsupported_data_conditions: true 5h/2h/60m alignment unbacktestable — shadow mode only

rejected.reason: marginal expectancy (val +0.21), turns negative at +20bps slippage (-0.19), portfolio maxDD -37.6%
negative/near-zero expectancy (val -0.01, PF 0.998), negative in both regimes, portfolio sim blew up (-212% DD). Daily proxy cannot capture the intraday gap-hold structure the strategy actually needs
as an overlay on S1 it is a NO-OP — S1 already gates BULL-only, so results are identical to S1. Regime defense is retained as a PORTFOLIO-level rule, not a standalone strategy
